findings.text: No suite in `tests/nix_suites.json` owns this test, so `just test-full` collects it in `test-source` against the conformance runtime, which lacks the Belay surface package needed to compile the fixture. Fix: Register the file in the existing `surfaceChecks` Nix suite.

Both tests call `split_by_age_answer`, so a run with SQLite compiles the same Lean fixture and runs the same counterexample search twice. Fix: Share the compiled answer through a module-scoped pytest fixture.

The axiom audit expects only the refutation’s report, so replacing the fixed-migration example’s proof with `sorry` can leave the test green despite its claim that every proof uses only logical axioms. Fix: Name both concrete proofs, print their axioms, and require all three reports.

The status uses eight seconds of additional module elaboration time to infer proximity to the ten-second limit, although `sql.checkTimeLimit` counts only time spent waiting for compiled checker work. Fix: Keep the elaboration measurement and remove the proximity claim unless the timed portion was measured separately.

The fixture compiler’s 300-second limit is an inline policy literal despite the documented fixture timeout in `tests/s6_check_support.py`. Fix: Use `CHAIN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` or define a documented timeout specific to this fixture.
